To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed and implemented a state estimation algorithm that enables fast and accurate state estimation of high-fidelity battery models.
we have developed a state estimator for a lithium-ion battery model using orthogonal collocation.
we have developed a state estimator for the pseudo two-dimensional lithium-ion battery model based on an extended Kalman Filter algorithm for differential-algebric equations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a state estimation algorithm that is able to accurately estimate the states of a spatially resolved battery model.
the development of a fast, accurate and robust battery state-of-charge estimator based on a spatially resolved thermodynamic-electrochemical model of a lithium-ion battery.
the development and application of a novel battery state estimation algorithm for a high-fidelity battery model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this work has demonstrated that the proposed model-based state estimator can be used to accurately estimate battery states in real-time, and therefore has the potential to be implemented in a battery management system.
a high fidelity spatially resolved model can be used for state estimation with an EKF algorithm.

this paper presents a state estimation approach for the pseudo two-dimensional lithium-ion battery model that is able to rapidly estimate the model states with a low error despite significant initial error on state-of-charge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a state estimation algorithm that uses an orthogonal collocation discretisation of the pseudo- 2D model to estimate the states and parameters of a lithium-ion battery.
a high-fidelity lithium-ion battery model can be implemented using Chebyshevs orthogonal collocation and the resulting system can be used for state estimation.
the state estimation algorithm is capable of estimating the state-of-charge, state-of-health, and the temperature of a lithium-ion battery using a spatially resolved thermoelectrochemical model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the state estimation of the pseudo- 2D model is possible using a modified version of the standard extended Kalman filter for PDAEs.
the pseudo-2-D model can be efficiently implemented using orthogonal collocation, which enables the use of this model in state-of-the-art battery management systems.
the pseudo-2 D model is able to capture the dynamics of a lithium-ion battery at high C-rates and that the model is suitable for state estimation purposes.
